# Nets for the Boats

*Saltgulls come in off the Wrack Ledges and tear Agna's nets on the drying racks. Take a mended net to Sorcha, then defeat 50 Saltgulls.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Agna](../npcs/agna_netmender.md) |
| Level | 42 |
| After | [Torn Nets](../quests/agna_torn_nets.md) |

## Objectives

1. Talk to [Sorcha](../npcs/sorcha_fisher.md)
2. Defeat 50 [Saltgull](../monsters/saltgull.md)

## Rewards

- 23,200 EXP
- 1,700 mesos
- [Highland Jumper](../items/highland_jumper.md) x1
- +30 standing with Goa Harbour
- +200 standing with [Agna](../npcs/agna_netmender.md)
